text: abdomen: Hepatomegaly with multiple hypodense lesions in both hepatic lobes, consistent with metastases. Mild splenomegaly. No ascites.
abdomen: A 4 cm exophytic solid mass arises from the lower pole of the right kidney. The left kidney is normal. No retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy.
